newsitem.title: GERMANY: Body identified as kidnapped German businessman.
newsitem.headline: Body identified as kidnapped German businessman.

text.p: A body found in woodland outside Frankfurt on Saturday was definitely that of a German multi-millionaire kidnapped more than two weeks ago, police said on Sunday.
Police had said on Saturday "with all probability verging on certainty" that the body was that of Jakub Fiszman but added they needed more time for a formal identification.
A father and son suspected of playing a central role in the kidnapping have been in police custody for several days.
Prosecutors said on Friday the son had confessed to helping with the kidnap and that he and his father had taken Fiszman to the woodland area a few days after his October 1 abduction.
Fiszman's brother Georg paid a ransom of four million marks ($2.6 million) on October 10, but the kidnappers reneged on an agreement and failed to free him the following day.
The last sign that Fiszman was alive came the day after his kidnap, when he made a telephone call to a friend.
